meta.description: Build publication-quality figures in R with ggplot2 using the grammar of graphics (data + aesthetics + geometries + scales + facets + themes) with CVD-safe palettes, cairo_pdf TrueType embedding, programmatic aes via tidy evaluation, and the theme_classic publication baseline. Use when producing static figures in R for papers, presentations, or reports.
meta.execution_note: Executed 5/5 inputs plus a block-by-block run of every SKILL.md snippet. R 4.4.3 via r.sh (ggplot2 4.0.3, ggtext 0.2.0, ggrepel 0.9.8, ggrastr 1.0.2, patchwork 1.3.2) and every script re-run under r-gg35.sh (ggplot2 3.5.2); only differences: p$labels is empty until build on 4.0 and theme_classic's panel.grid element. Each figure was asserted on ggplot_build() layer data against the input (real Bioconductor airway DESeq2 results and counts; synthetic sets labelled per input), PDFs inspected with run/pdfinfo.py (fonts, MediaBox, images), TIFF with PIL, and the key PNGs opened. Shipped example run from run/skill (copy), clone untouched.

scientific_integrity.detail: References (Wickham 2010 JCGS 19(1):3-28, Wickham 2016 ggplot2 2nd ed, Wilkinson 2005) are real; no fabricated statistic or DOI. Factual errors found (ggtext string, rasterize, 'blue') are recorded as P1/P2, not integrity failures.

practice_boundaries.detail: Plotting Skill for research data; no diagnostic, prescriptive or patient-level content.

methodological_ground.detail: No principled fallacy. The example volcano's dashed line at raw p = 0.05 beside padj-based colouring is a mislabelled threshold, recorded P1, not a fallacy that inverts a conclusion.

code_usability.detail: Every R block and the shipped example parse and run on ggplot2 4.0.3 and 3.5.2. Faulty behaviour (literal \u2212 label, ignored rasterize parameter, inert scale) produces a figure or warning rather than a crash and each has a working alternative documented in the recommendations.

functional_suitability.note: Covers grammar, geoms, scales, facets, theme, tidy eval, ggtext, export. Correctness 2/4: five verified factual errors (ggtext \u2212 string, geom_point(rasterize=TRUE), aes(color='red') 'blue', ggrepel N>10 claim, label_log on free-y panels) plus a nonsense axis-line tip

reliability.note: Version-drift note says to introspect, but there is no error handling or verification step; silent failures (unknown parameter rasterize, inert scale_color_manual, {{ }} with strings) are not called out

performance_context.note: 283-line SKILL.md plus a short usage guide, one example; a little repetition between SKILL.md and usage-guide.md

agent_usability.note: Clear layered structure and a good Common Failure Modes section; inconsistent doctrine (cairo_pdf/mm/Okabe-Ito in SKILL.md, default pdf/inches/Set1/Set2/NPG colours in the shipped example), no instruction to open or verify the output

human_usability.note: Natural trigger wording and example prompts; strict-example forgiveness is fine for R, but the usage guide's 'panel.grid.off' and 'remove top/right axis lines with element_line()' would mislead

security.note: No credentials or network; tidy eval used correctly (.data pronoun, no eval(parse())); writes only to paths the caller supplies

maintainability.note: One SKILL.md, one usage guide, one example file, clean separation; no tests or version-pinned expectations, example not exercised by anything

agent_specific.note: Description precise; related skills are named and exist; jitter and ggrepel are unseeded so figures are not reproducible; no escape hatch for when a figure is better made elsewhere or how to check it

final.grade_note: Numeric score 75 is in the Limited Release band, but the assertion pass rate 16/25 (64%) is below the 80% Limited Release floor in scoring_rubric.md section 5, so the grade drops one tier to Beta Only. No veto fired and no P0 is open.

key_strengths: Core grammar, tidy evaluation (.data[[var]], {{ }}, !!sym()), facet, scale and theme guidance is correct: all 30+ snippets build on ggplot2 4.0.3 and 3.5.2 and the numbers behind the plots match the input
cairo_pdf and mm-based export advice is verified: 89 x 70 mm PDF, 3 embedded TrueType fonts, 0 Type 3; default ggsave leaves unembedded Helvetica exactly as claimed
ggrastr::rasterise recipe cuts a 50,000-point PDF from 1.85 MB to 85 KB with vector text intact; TIFF LZW verified
Common Failure Modes section targets real pitfalls (units, aes vs constant, aes_string, linewidth) and the aes_string and linewidth warnings reproduce as described

recommendations.title: ggtext '\u2212' label prints a literal backslash sequence
recommendations.problem: The Labels-with-ggtext snippet writes y = '\u2212log<sub>10</sub>(*p*)'; in R source that is backslash-u2212, so the opened PNG shows '\u2212log10(p)' instead of a minus sign.
recommendations.root_cause: A JSON/Python-style escape was pasted into an R single-quoted string.
recommendations.fix: Use '\u2212' with a single backslash ('−log<sub>10</sub>(*p*)') or the literal character, and add a note to open the rendered label.

recommendations.title: geom_point(rasterize = TRUE) is not a ggplot2 3.5+ feature
recommendations.problem: The Common Geoms block claims inline rasterisation in ggplot2 3.5+. On 3.5.2 and 4.0.3 it is ignored ('Ignoring unknown parameters: rasterize'), the PDF stays all-vector (1.85 MB, 0 images) and the failure is only a warning.
recommendations.fix: Delete the inline claim and keep only ggrastr::rasterise(geom_point(), dpi = 300); add that overplotting at large N also needs smaller points, alpha, hexbin or density.

recommendations.title: 'Grammar in Layers' block contradicts the Skill's own rules
recommendations.problem: The block calls scale_color_manual without mapping colour (inert), keeps default boxplot outliers under geom_jitter (drawn twice, against the 'always suppress' rule) and label_log() on default free-y breaks yields labels such as 10^3.48 and 10^2.7.
recommendations.root_cause: Block written as a syntax tour, never rendered.
recommendations.fix: Map colour = condition, add outlier.shape = NA, and use scale_y_log10() with breaks_log() or plain labels; note the y-axis title 'Expression (log10)' clashes with 10^n tick labels.

recommendations.title: Shipped example: threshold line, save function and axis label
recommendations.problem: create_volcano draws the dashed line at -log10(fdr_threshold) on raw p while colouring by padj (1,617 genes above the line are grey); save_publication_figure uses default pdf() in inches (unembedded Helvetica) against the Skill's own cairo_pdf + mm rule; expression(-Log[10]~P-value) draws a spaced '− Log10 P − value'.
recommendations.root_cause: Example was not checked against the doctrine or against the numbers behind the plot.
recommendations.fix: Drop the horizontal line or compute it as the smallest -log10(p) with padj < fdr; pass device = cairo_pdf and units = 'mm'; label with expression(-log[10](italic(p))).

recommendations.title: Failure-mode claims that do not reproduce
recommendations.problem: aes(color='red') points render #F8766D salmon (not 'blue'); ggrepel drops labels because of overlaps, not N > 10 (60 spread labels all drawn; 400 dense labels: 74 text grobs vs 405 with Inf) and no warning was observed at draw time in a non-interactive run.
recommendations.fix: Correct the colour statement, state the real trigger for label loss and tell the agent to count drawn labels.

recommendations.title: Minor doctrine and reproducibility gaps
recommendations.problem: usage-guide tip 'remove top/right axis lines with theme(axis.line = element_line())' does nothing (theme_classic has no top/right axes); panel.grid = element_blank() is redundant on 4.0.3; jitter and ggrepel are unseeded; {{ x_var }} with a string silently draws a constant; Set1 in create_pca_plot fails above 9 groups; ggplot2 4.0 builds labels at print time so p$labels is empty.
recommendations.root_cause: Tips not tested against a rendered figure or the current ggplot2.
recommendations.fix: Remove the axis-line tip, add position_jitter(seed=) and geom_text_repel(seed=), warn about {{ }} with strings, and note get_labs() for ggplot2 4.
